answer_1.quote: We now show that these gains generalize to real‑world language generation datasets such as the NYT summarization dataset ... We also evaluate on the E2E dataset, a benchmark for generating natural language descriptions from structured meaning representations.
answer_1.outputs: Generated summaries for NYT and XSum, generated descriptions for E2E

answer_2.quote: We evaluate hallucination reduction using automated metrics such as the hallucination rate, and we report ROUGE‑L and BLEU scores to assess summary quality. We also report area under the precision‑recall curve (auPR) and area under the ROC curve (auROC) for error‑tracing performance.
